question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.**

He looked around for Bunty or Vinay, (**but either off**) them was anywhere near him.
solution:
The correct answer is **"but neither of."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence uses **"either off"** which is incorrect. 
 
• The correct phrase to use in this sentence is **"neither of them"** instead of "ei
